problem_statement: When the shell is built with the shell_builtin_cmd_help_json module, the shell must provide a help_json command. Invoking help_json must print a single-line machine-readable JSON object describing the commands available to the shell. The JSON object must have a top-level "cmds" array. Each element of that array must be an object with string fields "cmd" and "desc", containing the command name and its description. The output must include every command that the shell can run.
